grades.reason: Describes coherent agents and caches for CMO operations and only mentions in passing that CBO operations cover coherent instruction caches. It never describes the synchronization (such as FENCE.I) needed before fetching modified code, so it gives only limited background.
Covers which CMO instructions can raise illegal-instruction or virtual-instruction exceptions. It says nothing about instruction cache synchronization after code modification.
Covers xv6 inode locking and the inode cache. It is unrelated to instruction cache synchronization after code modification.

Describes SFENCE.VMA, which orders updates to page tables and invalidates address-translation caches. It does not cover synchronizing instruction fetch with modified code, which is the job of FENCE.I.
